summary: NivXRay Phase 3 · Cycle B (Office OOXML Analyzer + Threat Summary Card) end-to-end certification. Backend pytest suite (Office/Artifact-Intelligence/PE/BinaryTerminalState/BrokenPayloadDiagnostics/IEDDE-SSOT) passed 37/37. Public REST endpoints (auth-gated) all satisfied contract: /api/artifacts/capabilities lists 3 analyzers with office available:true; /api/artifacts/analyze on fabricated .docx returned artifact_type=office, confidence=99, capability_available=true, overview.family='docx', triggers include AutoOpen+Document_Open, findings contain all 4 required codes (vba_macros_present, macro_autoexec_trigger, external_template, external_urls_present) and are severity-sorted; plain zip returns artifact_type=unknown; determinism confirmed (identical JSON on repeated calls). /api/decode/smart on latin-1-encoded .docx bytes returned iedde_terminal_state='binary_artifact_recovered', binary_artifact.kind='ZIP', routed_analysis.artifact_type='office', capability_available=true, 4 findings. Frontend: admin login → paste latin-1 docx → click btn-nivxray-decode → Recovery Status Ribbon shows 'Binary Artifact Recovered / ZIP'; ThreatSummaryCard rendered with verdict='Malicious', risk contains 'HIGH', threat-signal-vba-macros='YES', SHA-256 shown; OfficeAnalysisPanel rendered with 4 finding cards + office-metadata section. PE flow still renders ThreatSummaryCard (verdict Benign for malformed PE stub) with legacy PE section beneath. IEDDE Decision Trace, Recipe, Pipeline Trace, Output panels all still render.
critical_code_review_comments: Office analyzer uses stdlib zipfile only — no new dependencies, complies with 'no optional-capability library' constraint.
ThreatSummaryCard verdict derivation is deterministic and screenshot confirms severity→verdict mapping (critical findings → Malicious).
Auth is required on /api/artifacts/* (403 without token) — desired behavior, consistent with rest of app.
